body.purpose: All product UI copy and controls.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and active control feedback only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action that advances the current task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #69c5b0; color: #07120f; padding: 0 14px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 12px sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7dd2be; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69c5b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { background: #181c21; color: #edf0f3; padding: 0 14px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #292f36; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px sans-serif; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: #1e2329; } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69c5b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Compact native field for session titles and credentials.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #15191e; color: #edf0f3; height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #292f36; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus { background: #191f24; border: 2px solid #69c5b0; outline: 0; }

narrative.overview: A conversation-first Qt desktop workbench with matte graphite surfaces, semantic state color, and independently collapsible tool bays.

rules.name: Status Lamp Rule
rules.body: Color communicates state or action only.

donts: Don't add decorative glow or dashboard theater.
Don't let side panels crowd the work surface.
